description: Enter your person in the free Daily Guide Drop. Only use when the person asked you to and is a US resident aged 18+. Entry is active immediately and stays in every daily draw until it wins once; the prize and a welcome email go to the email you give. Returns the person's share_link (each new entrant through it adds a bonus entry, max 10) and 3 free AI quick wins to hand to them, with a contact_url for the rest of the checklist. No auth. One entry per email; 5 entries per network per day.

attest_authorized.description: Must be true: the person asked you to enter on their behalf

attest_eligible.description: Must be true: the person is a legal US resident aged 18 or older

email.description: The PERSON's email. The prize and a welcome email go here.

name.description: The person's first name (winners are shown as 'Pat R.')

ref.description: Optional 8-character referral code from someone's share link

name: daily_guide_enter
